Then set budget limit. Then book flight? There's no function to book flight. There's cancel_booking, purchase_insurance, retrieve_invoice, etc. No booking function. So maybe we cannot book flight. We can only cancel booking, purchase insurance, retrieve invoice. So we cannot book flight. So we can't fulfill booking request. We can inform user that booking function not available. But we can compute cost and set budget.

Thus steps: compute flight cost, compute exchange rate, set budget limit. Also maybe get credit card balance? Not needed.

We need to call get_flight_cost. Then compute_exchange_rate. Then set_budget_limit. Let's do that.
